name: Kunal Kukreja
player_statement:
A complete player, Kunal Kukreja has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 14*, with an average of 6.14 and a quick strike rate of 66.15. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 1 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 14.0 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 7.93. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
